elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to each Party.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 states that “each Party's total aggregate liability” is subject to the cap.

elements.element: The fee-based limb of the cap includes both Fees paid and Fees payable.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 expressly uses “Fees paid or payable by Customer.”

elements.element: The fee-based limb measures the twelve months preceding the claim.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 measures the twelve months preceding “the event giving rise to the claim,” not the twelve months preceding the claim. Those dates can differ, so the required trigger is not present.

elements.element: The cap is the greater of the applicable twelve-month fee amount and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 expressly uses the greater of its fee-based limb and USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Indirect damages are mutually excluded.
elements.evidence: Section 21.2 provides that “neither Party” is liable for indirect damages, subject to Excluded Claims and legal excludability.

elements.element: Consequential damages are mutually excluded.
elements.evidence: Section 21.2 provides that “neither Party” is liable for consequential damages, subject to Excluded Claims and legal excludability.

elements.element: Liability for breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Confidentiality breaches are Excluded Claims under Section 21.3, and Section 21.1 applies the cap only “Except for Excluded Claims.”

elements.element: Liability for breach of data-protection obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Data-protection breaches are Excluded Claims under Section 21.3 and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Liability for breach of security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Security breaches are Excluded Claims under Section 21.3 and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Liability arising from indemnification obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims under Section 21.3 and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Liability for gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Gross negligence is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3 and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Liability for wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Wilful misconduct is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3 and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Liability for fraud is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Fraud is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3 and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Liability for infringement of the other Party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3 and therefore outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not damages for purposes of the liability cap.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 protects only Customer's obligation to pay “undisputed Fees for conforming Services.” It does not state that all Customer payment obligations are not damages and outside the cap.

elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to each Party.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 subjects “each Party's total aggregate liability” to the same cap.

elements.element: The mutual cap is no lower than twelve months' Fees.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 uses twelve months of Fees paid or payable as one limb of a greater-of formula. The USD 1,000,000 floor can increase, but cannot reduce, that twelve-month amount.

elements.element: Liability arising from indemnification obligations is carved out of the cap.
elements.evidence: Indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims under Section 21.3, and Excluded Claims are outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Liability for breach of confidentiality obligations is carved out of the cap.
elements.evidence: Confidentiality breaches are Excluded Claims under Section 21.3 and are outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Liability for gross negligence is carved out of the cap.
elements.evidence: Gross negligence is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3 and is outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Liability for wilful misconduct is carved out of the cap.
elements.evidence: Wilful misconduct is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3 and is outside the Section 21.1 cap.

result.reason: The rendered clause satisfies the fallback and nearly all preferred requirements. Preferred compliance fails because the fee lookback runs from the event giving rise to the claim rather than from the claim, and the payment-obligation treatment is limited to undisputed Fees for conforming Services rather than all Customer payment obligations. The redline otherwise implements a mutual greater-of cap and makes all stated Excluded Claims uncapped without disturbing unrelated terms.
